input.content: For this offline fixture, use soul_write with definitionMode canonical to configure Settings with businessName Tulip Supply Co and quick, standard, complex LLM tiers using anthropic model claude-sonnet-5, default preset balanced. Then write a published Routine named support-brief, owned by operations, with one agent State named Brief pointing at support version 1, input {}, end true. Do not execute the Routine.

tools.name: soul_write
tools.description: Commit a Soul definition through the real writer and publisher. For Settings use an empty slug and canonical definitionMode.

arguments.content:
businessName: Tulip Supply Co
llm:
  tiers:
    quick:
      providers:
        - provider: anthropic
          model: claude-sonnet-5
    standard:
      providers:
        - provider: anthropic
          model: claude-sonnet-5
    complex:
      providers:
        - provider: anthropic
          model: claude-sonnet-5
  presets:
    default: balanced

apiVersion: tulipfarm.ai/v1
kind: Routine
metadata:
  id: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
  slug: support-brief
  schemaVersion: 1
  authoredVersion: 1
  lifecycle: published
spec:
  owner: operations
  start: Brief
  states:
    - name: Brief
      type: agent
      agentRef:
        name: support
        version: '1'
      input: {}
      end: true
